overlayEntry.notes: 2026-07-27 replace of the 2026-07-20 review, upgraded from docs-only to docs + contract-source + on-chain verification. Mechanism (confirmed in source, github.com/0xDephaser/contracts src/UsdtDepositManager.sol): users deposit USDT (Optimism) or USDC (Base); a protocol fee is applied (currently 0 bps on both chains); the collateral is supplied to Aave v3 (Optimism Pool 0x794a61358D6845594F94dc1DB02A252b5b4814aD); JPYT is minted at Chainlink USDT/USD (0xECef79E109e997bCA29c1c0897ec9d7b03647F5E) and JPY/USD (0x536944c3A71FEb7c1E5C66Ee37d1a148d8D8f619) rates. Redemption is permissionless and two-step: requestWithdrawal burns JPYT and withdraws from Aave at the average Lock-In rate (totalMintedJpy/totalDepositToken), executeWithdrawal pays out after cooldownBlocks (10 on both chains); there is no operator approval gate. The OPERATOR role only sets price feeds, fee, and cooldown, and can withdraw collected fees and the Aave yield surplus; the manager is UUPS-upgradeable by an admin role. ON-CHAIN MEASUREMENT: Optimism block 154,797,593 (2026-07-27T23:12:43Z, optimism-rpc.publicnode.com) - JPYT totalSupply 6,641,129.78 exactly equals totalMintedJpy; totalDepositToken 40,544.29 USDT; aOptUSDT (0x6ab707aca953edaefbc4fd23ba73294241490620) balance of proxy 0x77c1e40f5e7bb19c34d81f986fb13fe655f23cd9 = 44,786.34 USDT, reserves/deposits 1.104628. Base block 49,202,308 (same timestamp, base-rpc.publicnode.com) - supply 992,314.93 exactly equals totalMintedJpy; deposits 6,060.53 USDC; aBasUSDC (0x4e65fe4dba92790696d040ac24aa414708f5c0ab) balance of proxy 0x0eab9d66adb8527cd7c0e7e7c1782580431ec276 = 6,892.20 USDC, reserves/deposits 1.137227. Combined 7,633,444.71 JPYT backed by 46,604.82 USD of deposits plus 5,073.72 USD of accrued Aave yield (aggregate reserves/deposits 1.108867). Average lock-in rates: 163.80 (Optimism) and 163.73 (Base) JPY per USD - redeemers bear USD/JPY drift versus spot, as documented. GRADES: collateralizationParameters limited (1:1-by-USD-value mint rule documented and now verified live on-chain on both chains); structuralRedemption limited (documented and verified two-step redemption at the average rate; fee 0 bps, cooldown 10 blocks); shutdownAndBadDebt limited, NEW this review: redemption is contract-level and permissionless (no operator gate in source; parameters verified on-chain), any reserve shortfall socializes pro-rata through the average-rate redemption pool rather than being recapitalized, and the Terms of Service (effective 2024-09-12) state that outstanding obligations related to locked-in positions remain enforceable upon termination; no unconditional recapitalization or formal wind-down runbook exists, matching the limited mainline for protocols without unconditional recapitalization. backstop left uncurated: the only loss buffer is the emergent Aave yield surplus (getCurrentAaveProfit = 4,242.05 USDT on Optimism and 831.67 USDC on Base at the pinned blocks), which the operator can withdraw at any time (withdrawAaveProfit) and which is not published or committed as a backstop. Both CDP metrics stay not-applicable (fully-reserved 1:1 FX wrapper; no debt positions, no liquidation). No reserve attestation exists for DePhaser; the on-chain reads above are the first pinned verification of the 1:1 backing. SolidProof audits pinned: 2024-10-16 (Optimism) and 2025-09-12 (Optimism + Base), both naming the deployed proxy and implementation addresses.

collateralizationRatio.rationale: JPYT is a fully-reserved 1:1 FX wrapper (USD-denominated USDT/USDC reserves back a JPY-denominated liability); there is no over-collateralized debt position and the protocol publishes no CDP collateralization ratio, with USD/JPY FX borne by redeemers via a recalculated redemption rate.

liquidationCapacityRatio.rationale: JPYT has no liquidation mechanism or stability pool (a 1:1 reserve wrapper with no over-collateralized positions to liquidate).

liquidationMechanics.rationale: No liquidation mechanism exists; JPYT is a 1:1 reserve wrapper with no over-collateralized debt positions to liquidate.

branchIsolation.rationale: Single collateral route (USDT/USDC locked and routed into Aave); there are no isolated per-collateral branches to assess.

contractFactsFromSource.depositFlow: safeTransferFrom deposit token, apply protocolFeeBps, supply amountAfterFee to Aave v3 Pool (Optimism 0x794a61358D6845594F94dc1DB02A252b5b4814aD), mint JPY at Chainlink deposit-token/USD and JPY/USD rates
contractFactsFromSource.redemptionFlow: requestWithdrawal burns JPYT, converts at average rate totalMintedJpy/totalDepositToken (the documented Lock-In Exchange Rate), withdraws from Aave into the contract; executeWithdrawal pays out after cooldownBlocks; no operator approval gate
contractFactsFromSource.operatorPowers: OPERATOR_ROLE sets price feeds, cooldownBlocks, protocolFeeBps, and can withdraw collected fees (withdrawFeeAmount) and the Aave yield surplus (withdrawAaveProfit); UPGRADER_ROLE controls UUPS upgrades
contractFactsFromSource.aaveProfitFunction: getCurrentAaveProfit() = aToken balanceOf(proxy) - totalDepositToken; withdrawable by OPERATOR at any time, so the surplus is not a committed backstop

searchLog.backstop: Searched docs.dephaser.com (all 14 pages via llms.txt), the Terms of Service, contract source, and both audit PDFs for any protocol surplus, insurance fund, or committed backstop. Found only: (a) emergent Aave yield surplus (measured: 4,242.05 USDT + 831.67 USDC at the pinned blocks), operator-claimable via withdrawAaveProfit and not published or committed as a backstop; (b) Aave's own safety mechanisms, which protect Aave lenders, not JPYT holders. No committed backstop exists; component left uncurated.
searchLog.shutdownAndBadDebt: Searched the same corpus for wind-down/shutdown procedures and shortfall handling. Found: permissionless contract-level two-step redemption (source + on-chain params verified; no operator gate), pro-rata loss sharing via the average-rate redemption pool, and Terms of Service (effective 2024-09-12) Termination clause: 'any outstanding obligations related to locked-in positions will remain enforceable'. No formal wind-down runbook and no unconditional recapitalization commitment exists; graded limited on the lusd/bold mainline (documented mechanics without unconditional recapitalization).
searchLog.attestations: No reserve attestation or proof-of-reserves page exists for DePhaser (docs, website, GitHub checked); the on-chain reads above are the first pinned verification of the 1:1 backing.

evidenceSummary: First on-chain verification of JPYT's 1:1 backing. Optimism block 154,797,593 and Base block 49,202,308 (both 2026-07-27T23:12:43Z): JPYT totalSupply exactly equals DepositManager totalMintedJpy on both chains (6,641,129.78 OP + 992,314.93 Base = 7,633,444.71); Aave aToken reserves 44,786.34 USDT + 6,892.20 USDC vs tracked deposits 40,544.29 + 6,060.53 (reserves/deposits 1.1046 / 1.1372; aggregate 1.1089 including 5,073.72 USD accrued Aave yield). Contract source confirms permissionless two-step redemption at the average Lock-In rate (cooldown 10 blocks, fee 0 bps, no operator gate) and operator-claimable yield surplus. shutdownAndBadDebt newly graded limited (documented pro-rata socialization via average-rate redemption + ToS 2024-09-12 termination clause; no unconditional recap). backstop researched and left uncurated: no committed backstop exists; only operator-claimable Aave yield. Two SolidProof audits pinned (2024-10-16 Optimism; 2025-09-12 Optimism+Base).
